title: no way pumpkin blur
description: Removes the pumpkin overlay blur for clear vision while wearing a carved pumpkin.
body:
No Pumpkin Blur removes the dark blurry overlay shown when wearing a carved pumpkin, giving you a clean screen and full visibility while keeping pumpkin functionality intact.

Features:

Removes pumpkin blur overlay
Clear full-screen visibility
Vanilla-friendly
Lightweight
No gameplay advantage beyond visual clarity

Important:

Cosmetic/visual change only
Keeps normal pumpkin mechanics
Simple compatibility with most resource packs
